ambient_definitions.body: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F : Matrix α β ℝ), @QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.FactorsThrough α β ι inferInstance F = (∃ A : Matrix α ι ℝ, ∃ B : Matrix ι β ℝ, F = A * B)
ambient_definitions.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.FactorsThrough
ambient_definitions.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι], Matrix α β ℝ → Prop

ambient_definitions.body: ∀ (a : ℝ) (p : Polynomial ℝ), Polynomial.taylor a p = p.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C a)
ambient_definitions.name: Polynomial.taylor
Matrix.mul_apply
ambient_definitions.type: ∀ {α β ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : Matrix α ι ℝ) (B : Matrix ι β ℝ) x y, (A * B) x y = ∑ i, A x i * B i y

ambient_definitions.body: ∀ {α β : Type*} [Fintype β] (A : Matrix α β ℝ), A.rank = Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range A.mulVecLin)

ambient_definitions.type: ∀ {α β : Type*} [Fintype β], Matrix α β ℝ → ℕ

ambient_definitions.body: For a matrix M : Matrix α β ℝ with [Fintype β], its linear map acts by (M.mulVecLin v) i = ∑ j, M i j * v j.

formal_context.target: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Fintype β] (p : Polynomial ℝ) (d : ℕ) (hd : p.natDegree ≤ d) (row : α → ℝ) (col : β → ℝ), (∀ x y, p.eval (row x + col y) = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (Polynomial.taylor (row x) p).coeff (i : ℕ) * col y ^ (i : ℕ)) ∧ @QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.FactorsThrough α β (Fin (d + 1)) inferInstance (fun x y => p.eval (row x + col y)) ∧ (Matrix.rank (fun x y => p.eval (row x + col y) : Matrix α β ℝ) ≤ d + 1)
